mira: Quick bug report — when creating ephemeral API keys from the Console (Test -> Create ephemeral key) the request appears to be billed to the org instead of the selected project. Saw on customer call.
mira: Repro steps: 1) Console > Test API 2) Create ephemeral key, choose project=proj-marketing 3) Send request -> quota shows on org:org-acme.
mira: Example headers from trace: `Authorization: Bearer ephem-abc123; X-Creation-Source=console; X-Console-Project=proj-marketing; X-Org=org-acme`
mira: Router log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:04Z] req=req_0x9a3 claims={"token_origin":"ephemeral","project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=missing_effective_project
```
tony: Hmm. Could be the token minting path not embedding project in the token claims. Console adds X-Console-Project header but our proxy may drop it for ephemeral flows.
eli: Two options: A) At mint-time, embed effective_project into the JWT/claim so router never needs the header. B) Make proxy preserve console headers for ephemeral token issuance flows. Prefer A for long term.
billing: If this affected live customers we might have small mis-billing. Can you produce a short list of sample request ids and affected projects so we can scope refunds?
ops-bot: deploy: canary keygen-service v1.5 and router v3.22 scheduled 02:00 UTC. Feature-flag gate: authz:ephemeral-project-claim.
tony: If we embed project in token claims we must ensure users can't set arbitrary project (console should validate membership/role). Security check mandatory.
eli: Agreed. Implementation sketch: keygen service validates project membership, then sets claim `effective_project=proj-marketing` in token payload and signs. Router will prefer token_claims.effective_project over headers. Also add telemetry tag `billing_charge_via=token_claim|console_header|sa_owner`.
mira: Can we also add a lightweight Console confirmation modal when creating ephemeral keys: "This key will be billed to proj-marketing (org: org-acme)" with a link to set default project for ephemeral keys? — reduces support noise.
tony: +1. Also add a fast debug header `X-Debug-Force-Project` usable only in internal envs so SRE can reproduce without UI changes.
billing: Please include a migration runbook and a query to detect affected tokens (tokens minted in the last 7 days with origin=console and missing effective_project claim). We'll review for credits.
eli: Plan: 1) PR to keygen service to attach project claim + validation (small change) 2) PR to router to honor token_claims.effective_project first and add telemetry enum `billing_charge_via` 3) Console UX modal + doc link 4) Canary behind flag `authz:ephemeral-project-claim` 5) Run detection query post-canary and coordinate with billing.
mira: I'll open PRs for 1 & 3 and include unit tests and sample traces. ETA PRs: 4h.
tony: Ops: please ensure canary env exposes billing dashboards for the flag so we can watch charge_target distribution. Add alert: if org billing spikes >0.5% vs baseline for canary cohort, auto-rollback.
ops-bot: note: add rollout ticket to release war room and tag #support #billing for customer comms.
billing: Thanks — will standby for the detection query and a small export of affected request ids.
mira: Will post PR links here and a short checklist when ready. Thanks all :rocket:
